title: Syllabus
text:
Policies






NoteIn-Class




Be respectful to the instructor and your fellow classmates.
Laptops/tablets are welcome for note-taking and participation only.









TipOut-of-Class




Start assignments early — technical work takes time to debug.
Academic integrity and independent work are expected.









WarningArtificial Intelligence



See Laurier’s Generative AI Policy.
My own policy: spend at least 15 minutes diagnosing a problem yourself before turning to AI tools. Later in the course, using AI will actually be a required component of the final project.

title: Syllabus
text:
First-Year Success Tips

Start early — avoid last-minute coding stress.
Practice daily — even 30 minutes a day beats cramming.
Ask questions early — reach out after 15 minutes of being stuck. Use office hours.
Form study groups — accountability helps.

title: About
text:
Teaching Philosophy








Note🧑‍🏫 Teaching Approach




Hands-on Learning: Real datasets, critical inquiry, practical problem-solving.
Active Classroom: Interactive coding sessions and collaborative experimentation.










Tip🚪 Open Door Policy




First-Year Support: Transitioning to university can be challenging — support is always available.
Open Discussion: Office hours and discussion forums are safe spaces to clarify concepts.

title: About
text:
What I Hope to Teach








Note🧠 Analytical Mindset



Formulate precise questions, structure complex problems, and analyze data objectively without bias.









Tip💻 Technical Fluency



Build confidence with modern open-source tools, repeatable workflows, and clean coding principles.









Warning💬 Data Communication



Translate statistical results into compelling visual narratives for technical and business audiences.

title: DATA100: Introduction to Data Analytics
text:
Welcome to DATA100 — Introduction to Data Analytics! This course introduces you to the fundamentals of data analysis using R, covering everything from R basics and data types to R Markdown/Quarto reporting, data wrangling, and communicating results.






NoteInstructor



Agassi Iu · Wilfrid Laurier University Office Hours: Wednesdays 14:00–16:00, LH3073 (or by appointment)
